Independent Qt6.12 RHI/OpenGL captures of bar/tools/glyph_probe.qml, emitted by
the private parity host. JetBrainsMono Nerd Font U+F303,17px bold, #89b4fa;
transparent or the translucent bar rectangle, DPR1/2. Runtime does not use Qt.
Generation/provenance: bar/artifacts/glyph-native-integrated/metrics.json and
bar/artifacts/glyph-material-sampler-gl (actual Qt shader/sampler trace).
The ignored native_gl integration test is run explicitly in private Weston.

Island exactness adds `mask@1/2.png` and `clip@1/2.png`: independent installed
Qt6.12/OpenGL captures of `hyprv-ui-island/tools/{mask,clip}_probe.qml`, generated
by `capture_mask.py`. Mask uses a fractional origin (17.375,10.25), 40px layer,
11px radius, opacity0.91, threshold0.5/spread1. Clip uses a70×38.75px rounded
rectangle at(5,10), exposing viewport-scissor half rounding. Both tests assert
exact premultiplied pixels; no runtime Qt dependency. SHA receipts are in the
island `artifacts/{mask,clip}-probe/oracle.json`.

`batch@1/2.png` independently captures island/tools/batch_probe.qml: a scaled
sibling forces the compatible smoothcolor batch to retain full matrices, including
its unscaled circle. Generated by QT_PROBE=batch capture_mask.py; receipt in
island/artifacts/batch-probe/oracle.json.

`layer-projection@{1,2}.png`: installed Qt6.12, generated by
`hyprv-ui-panels/tools/core_capture_layer.py` from `core_layer_probe.qml`.
AnimatedGlassPanel's548x572 source has explicit layer.textureSize at each DPR,
while MultiEffect captures the612x636 auto-padded logical extent. The3072x1728
viewport is preserved. Oracle hashes: panels/artifacts/core-panels/layer-oracle/oracle.json.
This catches a one-float-step projection error that changes one source alpha byte
and three composited edge pixels at DPR1. No canonical parity references are edited.
